info.title: Hajj & Umrah Package Booking System API
info.description: REST API documentation for Hajj & Umrah package booking, seat reservations, installments, payments, cancellations, and administration.

name.description: Name of the Hajj or Umrah package

description.example: Includes 5-star hotel accommodations in Makkah and Madinah with full VIP transport.

type.description: Updated package type: HAJJ or UMRAH

version.description: Current entity version for optimistic locking

name.description: Name of the package tier (e.g. VIP, Economy, Standard)

quota.description: Total seat capacity allocated to this tier
Updated total quota (must not be lower than active held + confirmed seats)

version.description: Current entity version for optimistic locking

tier_id.description: UUID of the selected package tier

pilgrims.description: List of pilgrims included in this booking

reason.description: Reason for cancelling the individual pilgrim

booking_id.description: UUID of the booking to pay for

provider.description: Gateway provider name (e.g. SSLCOMMERZ, BKASH, NAGAD, STRIPE)

method.description: Payment method channel (e.g. CARD, WALLET, NET_BANKING)

event_id.description: Unique gateway notification or event identifier

status.description: Terminal payment status reported by gateway

signature.description: HMAC signature for webhook integrity verification

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata payload delivered from gateway

method.description: Manual collection method (e.g. CASH, BANK_TRANSFER, CHEQUE)

reference_number.description: Bank slip or cheque reference number

notes.example: Deposit confirmed at Sonali Bank Gulshan branch.

booking_id.description: UUID of the booking to cancel

pilgrim_ids.description: Specific pilgrim UUIDs to cancel (omit for full booking cancellation)

cancellation_fee.description: Optional admin cancellation penalty fee deducted from eligible refund

status.description: New refund state (PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or REJECTED)

transaction_reference.description: Bank or gateway disbursement reference code

reason.description: Reason for rejection or processing note
reason.example: Disbursement transferred to customer account via BEFTN

transaction_id.description: Unique gateway transaction or settlement identifier

amount.description: Settled amount reported by the gateway

settlement_date.description: Date/time string of the settlement report

provider.description: Gateway provider being reconciled (e.g. BKASH, SSLCOMMERZ, NAGAD)

settlements.description: Batch of settlement line items exported from payment provider

notes.description: Investigation notes, resolution details, or adjustment justifications
notes.example: Discrepancy resolved: Gateway fee of 1.5% was deducted prior to settlement batching.

name.description: Corporate or trade name of the vendor

type.description: Vendor operational category (HOTEL, TRANSPORT, AIRLINE, VISA, CATERING, OTHER)

currency.description: Default billing currency code (e.g. SAR, USD, BDT)

contact_person.description: Primary contact person or account representative

address.example: Abraj Al Bait Complex, King Abdul Aziz Endowment, Makkah

vendor_id.description: UUID of the vendor associated with this expense

package_id.description: Optional package UUID if expense directly pertains to a package cohort

description.description: Detailed description of the expense item
description.example: 50 VIP room bookings for 10 nights at Makkah Clock Royal Hotel

amount.description: Expense amount in original invoicing currency

currency.description: Currency ISO code (e.g. SAR, USD, BDT)

exchange_rate.description: Foreign exchange rate against BDT (e.g. 32.50 for SAR -> BDT)

payment_reference.description: Bank swift or remittance invoice reference

sku.description: Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier (e.g. IHRAM-MALE, BAG-WHEEL, SIM-STC)

category.description: Item category (e.g. APPAREL, LUGGAGE, TELECOM, OTHER)

initial_stock.description: Initial stock quantity to populate on creation

type.description: Transaction category: PURCHASE, ISSUE, RETURN, ADJUSTMENT

quantity.description: Quantity of items in this transaction

booking_id.description: Associated booking UUID (required for ISSUE transactions to pilgrims)

notes.example: Issued during orientation session at Dhaka office
